neighbours.label: In an English news report, the word that says a public situation is still dragging on or has been put off again: it is still under way ('now in its second year', 'shows no sign of easing', 'detectives are still seeking') or delayed once more ('postponed again', 'delayed once more'); the same phrases about personal life ('my diet is now in its third week'), recipes, fairy tales, market prices and static facts stay weak; a space-object flyby headline ('Asteroid Flyby') also fires
fire: The strike by rail workers, now in its second month, shows no sign of easing as talks collapsed on Tuesday.
Detectives are still seeking a man seen near the warehouse on the night of the fire, police said.
The opening of the new bridge has been postponed again, the city council announced on Monday.
The trial of the former mayor was delayed once more after a key witness fell ill.
The drought across the region, now in its third year, continues to threaten farmers' harvests.
Rescue teams are still searching for two hikers missing in the mountains since Friday.
The launch of the weather satellite has been pushed back yet again due to a fuel leak.
Fighting in the border town shows no sign of letting up, aid agencies warned.
quiet: A senior officer and his wife were caught spying for a foreign power.
By one estimate, this burden amounts to $80 billion per year.
The strike by rail workers ended on Tuesday after unions accepted a new pay offer.
Detectives arrested a man seen near the warehouse on the night of the fire, police said.
The new bridge opened on schedule, the city council announced on Monday.
The trial of the former mayor concluded with a guilty verdict on Wednesday.
My new diet is now in its third week and I still miss bread.
Let the dough rest for another hour until it shows no sign of sinking.

predictions: Blind label-only test (16 sentences written by a second author who saw only the label). Expect most fire items 0.2-0.5; the riskiest near misses are the resolved news twins (strike ended, detectives arrested), which probes put near 0.2. Loop-back after mapping neighbours: feeders L9/N3839- (space rocks) and L7/N11725+, L8/N3610+ (Tunguska names) explain the asteroid-flyby branch; readers L22/N2221+, L23/N11602+, L25/N10483- failed and do not constrain the label.
